\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{تعلم} (taʿallama)}{تعلم (taʿallama)}]{\ar{تعلم} (taʿallama) — to learn (he learned)}

\label{lesson:AR-C61-taallama}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for to cry, then the Arabic for to dance.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{تعلم}}
\textbf{\ar{تعلم}} — \emph{taʿallama} — \textquotedblleft{}to learn (he learned)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{تعلم}} (\emph{taʿallama}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{ʿ-l-m}, \textquotedblleft{}to know\textquotedblright{} (Lane). \emph{Taʿallama} is Form V, \textquotedblleft{}to get oneself taught\textquotedblright{}, to learn.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{أراد} (arāda)}{أراد (arāda)}]{\ar{أراد} (arāda) — to want (he wanted)}

\label{lesson:AR-C61-arada}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for to learn, then the Arabic for to forget.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{أراد}}
\textbf{\ar{أراد}} — \emph{arāda} — \textquotedblleft{}to want (he wanted)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{أراد}} (\emph{arāda}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{r-w-d}, \textquotedblleft{}to seek, to go to and fro seeking\textquotedblright{} (Lane). Form IV \emph{arāda} came to mean \textquotedblleft{}to will, to want\textquotedblright{} (Lane).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{أرسل} (arsala)}{أرسل (arsala)}]{\ar{أرسل} (arsala) — to send (he sent)}

\label{lesson:AR-C61-arsala}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for to forget, then the Arabic for to want.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{أرسل}}
\textbf{\ar{أرسل}} — \emph{arsala} — \textquotedblleft{}to send (he sent)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{أرسل}} (\emph{arsala}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{r-s-l}, \textquotedblleft{}to send; to let go\textquotedblright{} (Lane). Form IV \emph{arsala} is \textquotedblleft{}he sent\textquotedblright{}; the same root gives \emph{rasūl}, \textquotedblleft{}a messenger\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
